title: tooling-gaps: read_file on .moeb/signals/index.md exceeds 100 KiB cap requiring grep_files fallback
description: A direct read_file call on .moeb/signals/index.md returned an overflow result (57,058 characters, 177 lines exceeded the allowed token cap), requiring the agent to fall back to grep_files to locate the target row. As the index grows, this will become a recurring pattern on every fix_signal run that reads index.md.
proposed_resolution: Add a note to fix_signal.skill.md Phase 3 Index Update sub-procedure to use grep_files to locate the target row in index.md rather than read_file, since the index is expected to grow beyond the read cap.
